question: Review of the IEC datasheets against heat balance Rev B and the plant equipment list (review codes 2 on ALP-IEC-20MAA-ME-DSH-0001 Rev 0, ALP-IEC-10HAA-ME-DSH-0001 Rev B, ALP-IEC-10MBA-ME-DSH-0001 Rev A, ALP-IEC-10MKA-EL-DSH-0001 Rev 0, ALP-IEC-20MAG-ME-DSH-0001 Rev 0 and the GT / ST GA drawings): (1) update the ST datasheet LP flows to heat balance Rev B; (2) give the HRSG design temperatures per section; (3) state whether the GT 425 MW is shaft output and how it relates to IG-03 (418 MW at the terminals); (4) provide tags and ratings of the condensate preheater recirculation pumps, the HP / IP / LP bypass valves and dump devices, the generator neutral earthing and excitation transformers and the generator protection panels; (5) confirm the condenser circulating water design flow and give the water-side design and test pressure; (6) give the SFC starting load profile; (7) state the heaviest maintenance lift weights on the GT and ST GA drawings.
subject: EPC review of the power island datasheets: heat balance consistency, missing design data and tags
